title: Hydragen: High-Throughput LLM Inference with Shared Prefixes
authors: Jordan Juravsky; Bradley Brown; Ryan Ehrlich; Daniel Y. Fu; Christopher Ré; Azalia Mirhoseini
venue_full: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37 (NeurIPS 2024)
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Batched decoding with long shared prefixes repeatedly reads identical prefix KV and executes memory-bound matrix-vector attention, limiting throughput even when storage duplication is removed.
problem_statement.zh: 具有長共享 prefix 的 batched decoding 會重複讀取相同 prefix KV，並執行受 memory bandwidth 限制的 matrix-vector attention；即使移除儲存重複，throughput 仍受限制。

key_innovation.en: Hydragen exactly decomposes attention over shared prefixes and unique suffixes, then batches prefix queries across sequences to replace repeated matrix-vector operations with tensor-core-friendly matrix multiplication; it generalizes hierarchically to prefix trees.
key_innovation.zh: Hydragen 將 shared prefix 與 unique suffix 的 attention 精確分解，再跨 sequence 對 prefix query 進行 batching，以 tensor-core 友善的 matrix multiplication 取代重複 matrix-vector operation；亦可階層式延伸至 prefix tree。

baselines_compared: vLLM, FlashAttention, No Attention upper bound

key_improvements.en: Up to 32x CodeLlama-13B end-to-end throughput over vLLM; less than 15% throughput loss when prefix grows 1K to 16K versus over 90% for baselines; 55% additional inference-time reduction with hierarchical sharing on APPS.
key_improvements.zh: CodeLlama-13B 端到端 throughput 相較 vLLM 最高 32x；prefix 由 1K 增至 16K 時 throughput 降幅低於 15%，baseline 則超過 90%；APPS hierarchical sharing 額外降低 55% inference time。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 40GB, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA L40S

workloads_traces.en: Synthetic many-completions-from-one-prompt batches; 256 questions over War and Peace; 120 introductory APPS problems with 128 candidates each and two-level prompt sharing.
workloads_traces.zh: 合成的單一 prompt 多 completion batch；針對《War and Peace》的 256 個 questions；以及 120 個 APPS introductory problems，每題 128 candidates 且具兩層 prompt sharing。

key_parameters.en: FlashAttention 2.3.6 plus xFormers Triton; vLLM 0.2.7 baseline; main E2E CodeLlama-13B TP=8 on 8x A100 40 GB, shared prefix 2,048 and 128 generated tokens; separate batch 1,024 with prefix sweep 1,024-16,256; long document Yi-6B-200K on 4x A100 40 GB with approximately 19,947 tokens (appendix says 19,974) and 256 test questions; APPS CodeLlama-7B on 8x A100 40 GB, two 2,400-token examples, 128 candidates/problem, 512 output tokens. Arrival rate, tools, cache pressure, TTL, and server concurrency not stated.
key_parameters.zh: FlashAttention 2.3.6 搭配 xFormers Triton；baseline 為 vLLM 0.2.7；主要 E2E 使用 CodeLlama-13B、TP=8、8x A100 40 GB，共享 prefix 2,048、生成 128 tokens；另以 batch=1,024 對 prefix 1,024–16,256 進行 sweep；long document 使用 Yi-6B-200K、4x A100 40 GB，約 19,947 tokens（appendix 為 19,974）與 256 個 test questions；APPS 使用 CodeLlama-7B、8x A100 40 GB、兩個 2,400-token examples、每題 128 candidates、output 512 tokens。arrival rate、工具、cache pressure、TTL 與 server concurrency 未載明。

metrics_defined.en: Tokens/s, decode-only latency/throughput after subtracting one-token generation time, and total inference time excluding tokenization or prefix processing where noted; no TTFT, JCT, or hit rate.
metrics_defined.zh: Tokens/s、扣除 one-token generation time 後的 decode-only latency/throughput，以及在註明處排除 tokenization 或 prefix processing 的 total inference time；未定義 TTFT、JCT 或 hit rate。

headline_vs_realistic.en: Up to 32x over vLLM at large shared-prefix batches; at small batches the methods have similar throughput, while hierarchical APPS sharing reduces inference time by 55%.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: 在大型 shared-prefix batch 上相較 vLLM 最高 32x；小 batch 時各方法 throughput 相近，而 APPS hierarchical sharing 將 inference time 降低 55%。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: Hydragen requires each batched group to share an exact prefix KV; per-query topology changes that fragment exact-prefix groups reduce batching opportunity but do not affect correctness.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: Hydragen 要求同一 batch group 共享完全相同的 prefix KV；逐 query 拓撲變動若使 exact-prefix group 碎片化，會降低 batching 機會但不影響正確性。
